name: AmplitudeJS Formatters
description: Field formatters that render media/file audio fields as themed AmplitudeJS players (Single Song, Multiple Songs, Blue/White/Flat Black/Simple Black playlists, Visualization Player).
library_dependencies: michaelbromley visualizations 1.4.4 (external JS, Visualization Player only)
project_description: Submodule of the AmplitudeJS project. Provides seven field formatter plugins that render entity-reference (media) and file audio fields as themed AmplitudeJS HTML5 audio players, ported from the official AmplitudeJS example players. Formatter settings map token replacement patterns to each player's audio-file URL, title, artist, album, and album-art. Depends on core file + media, the contrib token module, and the base amplitudejs module for the JavaScript library.
